title: Permissions
description: Security sandbox for agents. Declares what the agent is allowed to access. Runtimes MUST enforce.

secrets.description: Secret references available to this agent. Values resolved by runtime.

allow_read.description: Glob patterns the agent can read. ['*'] = unrestricted.

allow_write.description: Glob patterns the agent can write. Overrides file_scope if both present.

deny.description: Glob patterns explicitly blocked. Deny takes precedence over allow.

allow.description: none = no network. restricted = only allowed_hosts. full = unrestricted.
Whether the agent can execute shell commands.

allowed_commands.description: Whitelist of allowed commands. Empty = all allowed (when allow=true).

CommunicationPermissions.description: Controls which agents this agent can communicate with. Omit for unrestricted. When set, runtimes MUST enforce — messages to/from unauthorized agents are dropped.

can_message.description: Agent names (or 'coordinator', 'user', '*') this agent can send messages to. '*' = unrestricted.

can_receive_from.description: Agent names (or 'coordinator', 'user', '*') this agent can receive messages from. '*' = unrestricted.

can_handoff_to.description: Agent names this agent can hand off tasks to. Empty = handoff disabled.

name.description: Secret identifier. Referenced as ${secrets.<name>} in the workflow.

source.description: Where the secret is resolved from. env = environment variable. vault = external secret manager. file = file on disk. runtime = runtime-provided.

key.description: Lookup key. For env: variable name. For vault: secret path. For file: file path.

required.description: If true, workflow fails if secret cannot be resolved.

McpPermissions.description: Controls which MCP servers and tools this agent can access. Omit for no MCP access. ['*'] grants access to all declared servers.

servers.description: Names of mcp_servers this agent can connect to. References workflow.mcp_servers[].name. ['*'] = access to all declared servers. Empty or omitted = no MCP access.

allow_tools.description: Allowlist of specific MCP tools in 'server:tool_name' format. When set, agent can ONLY call these tools. Omit to allow all tools on permitted servers. e.g. ['github:search_repositories', 'postgres:query'].

deny_tools.description: Blocklist of specific MCP tools in 'server:tool_name' format. Deny takes precedence over allow_tools. Useful for excluding destructive operations. e.g. ['postgres:execute_write', 'github:delete_repository'].
